description: At the Brauheck barracks near Cochem in the false code 25+33, applied in 1984 to mark 25 years of F-104 operations by JaboG 33 (International F-104 Society, last noted 30 May 2014; 916-starfighter German fate list, 2025). The 916-starfighter list also records the cockpit of RF-104G 24+11 at these barracks, while the Deutsch-Kanadisches Luftwaffenmuseum lists a 24+11 cockpit at Söllingen; that cockpit is recorded at Söllingen here.
